PawnColumnDef.label: score
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Breeding score: weighted average of this animal's genes using its species' breeding goal. 0% is average; higher is better.

PawnColumnDef.label: role
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Herd role. Breeder: may breed and is never auto-slaughtered. Keep: never auto-slaughtered. Cull: never breeds, slaughtered first.
